QuestInfo.name: Schegerazade's Second Riddle
QuestInfo.0: Alpha and Beta answered the first question without a problem, but there were still two questions left. Schegerazade was ready with the second riddle.
QuestInfo.1: Schegerazade, as her second question, tells you to bring her the #bmost shiny object of Ariant#k. You really have no clue this time. Maybe you can ask the people of Ariant what this can be.
QuestInfo.2: The answer to Schegerazade's second question was #t4033907#. That was the shiniest object in Ariant. This question was tougher, but Alpha and Beta still got it right. One question to go...

speech.0: The shiniest thing in Ariant? It's obviously me! You're blinded just looking at me, aren't you?
The shiniest thing in Ariant is none other than... Sirin! Oh, my Sirin...
You're looking for the shiniest thing in Ariant? Then look no further. It's everywhere!
speech.1: Yes, the sand. Nothing is shinier in a desert. #r#t4033907##k, which is mixed with gold, is blinding under the desert sun. You can get #r#t4033907##k by defeating #bDesert Giants#k at Outside North Entrance of Ariant.

no.0: Well, I guess you don't have the answer to my riddle after all.
